title: 搬了新家，怎么用英语跟邻居打招呼？
summary: 在美国，主动跟邻居打招呼是基本礼仪。这篇教你自我介绍、交换联系方式的说法，第一印象很重要。

featuredPhrase.en: We just moved in. We're your new neighbors!
featuredPhrase.zh: 我们刚搬来。我们是你的新邻居！

phrases.en: We just moved in. We're your new neighbors!
phrases.zh: 我们刚搬来。我们是你的新邻居！

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi! We just moved in next door. I'm Wang.
dialogue.zh: 你好！我们刚搬到隔壁。我姓王。

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.en: Welcome to the neighborhood! I'm John. Nice to meet you!
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到我们社区！我是 John。很高兴认识你！

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too! This is my wife, Li.
dialogue.zh: 我也很高兴认识你！这是我太太，李。

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.en: Hi Li! Where are you guys from?
dialogue.zh: 你好，李！你们原来是哪里人？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: We're originally from China. We love it here so far.
dialogue.zh: 我们原来从中国来。目前很喜欢这里。

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.en: That's great! Let's keep in touch. Here's my number.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！保持联系。这是我的电话。
